cases.name: root final status is done

cases.name: parallel region done raises done state event and transitions
cases.test: final.test.ts > final states > should emit the "xstate.done.state.*" event when all nested states are in their final states

cases.name: final child state actions run before parent onDone actions
cases.test: final.test.ts > final states > should execute final child state actions first

cases.name: final output reflects entry-updated context
cases.test: final.test.ts > final states > state output should be able to use context updated by the entry action of the reached final state

cases.name: parallel done event when both parallel children reach final
cases.test: final.test.ts > final states > should emit a done state event for a parallel state when its parallel children reach their final states

cases.name: parallel done event when compound child finishes after sibling already final
cases.test: final.test.ts > final states > should emit a done state event for a parallel state when its compound child reaches its final state when the other parallel child region is already in its final state

cases.name: parallel done event when parallel child finishes after compound sibling already final

cases.name: top-level final reached via parallel state done at start (flat)

cases.name: top-level final reached via nested parallel state done at start
cases.test: final.test.ts > final states > should reach a final state when a parallel state nested in a parallel state reaches its final state and transitions to a top-level final state in response to that

cases.name: outer parallel onDone event names the direct parallel child
cases.test: final.test.ts > final states > onDone of an outer parallel state should be called with its own "xstate.done.state.*" event when its direct parallel child completes

cases.name: onDone not called when reached only via initial resolution
cases.test: final.test.ts > final states > onDone should not be called when the machine reaches its final state

cases.name: machine stays active when only a parallel child of a compound state completes

cases.name: onDone of a parallel state fires once for simultaneous region completion

cases.name: parallel exit actions reversed order after later region transition
cases.test: final.test.ts > final states > should call exit actions of parallel states in reversed document order when the machines reaches its final state after later region transition

cases.name: parallel exit actions reversed order after multiple regions transition at once

cases.name: parallel root stays active when only compound region reaches final
cases.test: final.test.ts > final states > should not complete a parallel root immediately when only some of its regions are in their final states (final state reached in a compound region)

cases.name: parallel root stays active when only a direct final child is reached
cases.test: final.test.ts > final states > should not complete a parallel root immediately when only some of its regions are in their final states (a direct final child state reached)

cases.name: completes with a null output directly on root
cases.test: final.test.ts > final states > should be possible to complete with a null output (directly on root)

cases.name: completes with a null output resolving from the final state's own output
cases.test: final.test.ts > final states > should be possible to complete with a null output (resolving with final state's output)

cases.name: root final machine output receives the root's done event
cases.test: final.test.ts > final states > output of a machine with a root state being final should be called with a "xstate.done.state.ROOT_ID" event (the event the output function receives, written as the machine's output: its type, and no "output" member, which is JavaScript's undefined; that the function is called exactly once is not observable)

cases.name: a nested final state's output reaches the parent's onDone assign

cases.name: parallel root output receives the root's done event when a compound child's final child is reached
cases.test: final.test.ts > final states > root output should be called with a "xstate.done.state.*" event of the parallel root when a final child of its compound child is reached (the event the output function receives, written as the machine's output: its type, and no "output" member, which is JavaScript's undefined; that the function is called exactly once is not observable)

cases.name: parallel root output receives the root's done event when a final descendant two parallel levels deep is reached
cases.test: final.test.ts > final states > root output should be called with a "xstate.done.state.*" event of the parallel root when a final descendant is reached 2 parallel levels deep (the event the output function receives, written as the machine's output: its type, and no "output" member, which is JavaScript's undefined; that the function is called exactly once is not observable)

excluded.test: final.test.ts > final states > should only call data expression once when entering root's final state
excluded.reason: asserts that the machine's output function is called exactly once (toBeCalledTimes(1)); a case's output ("outputs") is a computed value, a pure function of the context and the event with no effect of its own, so the record holds only the value it gave, the same whether XState computed it once or twice; it would need an output with an effect the record shows, such as one that counts its calls

excluded.test: final.test.ts > final states > output mapper should receive self

excluded.test: final.test.ts > final states > root output should only be called once when multiple parallel regions complete at once
excluded.reason: asserts that the machine's output function is called exactly once when both regions of the parallel root complete in the same microstep (toBeCalledTimes(1)); a case's output ("outputs") is a computed value, a pure function of the context and the event with no effect of its own, so the record holds only the value it gave, the same whether XState computed it once or twice; it would need an output with an effect the record shows, such as one that counts its calls

excluded.test: final.test.ts > final states > should not resolve output of a final state if its parent is a parallel state
excluded.reason: asserts that the output function of a final state whose parent is parallel is never called (not.toHaveBeenCalled); a case's output ("outputs") is a computed value with no effect of its own that cannot fail, and the value it would give reaches no event (a parallel state's done event carries no output, and in this machine the parallel state never completes), so whether XState computes it leaves nothing in the record; it would need an output that records its calls, or one that fails
